// Added PostgreSQL connection pool
const { Pool } = require('pg');

const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL || 'postgres://admin:admin@localhost:5432/production',
  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
  connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000,
});

    await client.query('SELECT 1');

  }
});

readinessProbe:

  failureThreshold: 3
